metadata.title: The J-equation at the birational minimal slope
metadata.abstract: We prove the existence, uniqueness, and partial regularity outside a proper analytic subset for the Kähler current solving the $J$-equation at the birational minimal slope. This confirms Datar--Mete--Song's conjecture 1.5 in \cite{DMS26}. We introduce an analytic threshold, and prove its equivalence to the birational threshold introduced by Datar--Mete--Song. One of the key tools is the approximation of subsolution by Bergman's kernels, which is motivated by the work of Demailly on the approximation of plurisubharmonic functions with analytic singularities. As an application of the Bergman kernel approximation, we combine the results of Fang--Ma \cite{FM26} to give an analytic characterization of the $J$-null locus of a semistable pair $(\alpha,\beta)$. This removes the technical assumptions in \cite{L26b}.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.progressType: 双有理最小斜率处的 J 方程
analysis.workSummary: 证明双有理最小斜率处 J 方程的 Kähler 流解存在唯一，并在真解析子集外部分正则；建立解析阈值与双有理阈值等价。
analysis.breakthrough: 验证 Datar–Mete–Song 的相关猜想，并给出半稳定对 J-null 集的解析刻画。
analysis.limitations: 临界解一般为带奇性的 Kähler 流，不能声称在全流形上光滑。
analysis.priorityReason: 验证 Datar–Mete–Song 的相关猜想，并给出半稳定对 J-null 集的解析刻画。
